read.en: SanDisk rose 4.8% on Nov 3 to $1,126.52, trading between $1,100.53 and $1,153.19. It is below the falling 5-day ($1,217.5), 10-day ($1,252.5), 30-day ($1,487.2) and 100-day ($1,593.3) averages and below the rising 200-day ($1,266.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and below zero, histogram steady; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($1,389.18), and RSI is 34.
read.zh: SanDisk 11月3日上涨 4.8%，收于 $1,126.52，盘中区间 $1,100.53–1,153.19。股价位于下行的 5 日（$1,217.5）、10 日（$1,252.5）、30 日（$1,487.2）和 100 日均线（$1,593.3）下方，并低于上行的 200 日均线（$1,266.1）。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图持平；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$1,389.18），RSI 为 34。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $1,115–1,121 resistance (Oct 30 and Aug 3 lows), now support; the $1,153.2 high stalled inside the $1,150.9–1,159.3 zone. Resistance is $1,150.9–1,159.3 (Oct 30 close, Nov 2 and 3 highs), then $1,217.5–1,239 (5-day, Oct 23 and 26 lows) and $1,252.5–1,266.1 (10 and 200-day). Support is $1,100.5–1,121, then $1,048–1,067.4 and $998.2. A close above $1,159.3 would target $1,217–1,239; below $1,100, $1,048–1,067.
